notes.title: E-Startup 2: Version 1.0 is Here!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Entrepreneurs![/b]

I’m happy to share that E-Startup 2 has officially reached version 1.0! 

This update brings a much-requested feature: the template tool for production line management, making it easier to handle larger teams and optimize workflows. Alongside this, a few minor fixes and performance improvements have been added to polish the experience.


[b]New Template Tool[/b]
[list]
[*] A feature requested by the community! Assign templates to workers for quicker and simpler production line adjustments, saving time and improving efficiency.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44790705/81febb9acb5e481d04b90f69f8cc3dcf27dcdf70.png[/img]

That’s it for today! Thank you to everyone in the community for your feedback and patience as it really helped shaped the game during the year !

The update cycle will slow down as we’ve reached the targeted features set and the end of the year was the deadline to complete the 1.0 of the game as shared at the beginning of the year !

Stay tuned, though there’s an exciting new game on the horizon for the next year !

notes.title: E-Startup 2: Business Tycoon Launches Today!
notes.content:
🚀 E-Startup 2: Business Tycoon Launches Today!
[b]
Hello, Steam Community![/b]

I am thrilled to announce that E-Startup 2: Business Tycoon is available starting today, May 14, 2024! After much anticipation and feedback from those who played our prologue and demo, I decided it was time to bring the full experience to you ahead of the previously scheduled date.

[b]What to Expect:[/b]

[list]
[*] Engaging Gameplay: Dive into the world of entrepreneurship and navigate the challenges of building a business from the ground up.
[*] Continuous Updates: Development doesn't stop here. Throughout the year, I will be rolling out updates to add new features, refine gameplay, and incorporate your feedback to improve the game.
[*] Community Focus: Your input is invaluable. I encourage you to share your experiences, suggestions, and feedback to help shape the future of E-Startup 2.
Special Thanks:
A heartfelt thank you to everyone in the community for your support, patience, and enthusiasm. This game is a product of not just my efforts but also your valuable input and encouragement.
[/list]

E-Startup 2: Business Tycoon is now available for download. I look forward to seeing your business empires flourish and hearing about your experiences in the game.

[b]Happy gaming![/b]

notes.title: Training and Content Update - Version 0.3.1
notes.content:
[h3]Hello players![/h3]

Let's go into the exciting developments of this week with our latest update notes:

[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Employee Progression: We've introduced a dynamic system of employee levels, where each level enhances the base speed of your team members.
[*] Experience System: Employees now gain experience through their work, allowing them to level up and become even more effective.

[*] Realism Update: Employees who are fired will now walk away realistically instead of abruptly disappearing.

[*] Clickable Notifications: Some notifications are now clickable, instantly directing you to related elements such as opening the research panel when notified about a new product unlock.
[/list]

[h2]Balancing and Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We've addressed concerns regarding mood decline by implementing refined balancing adjustments to perks, bonuses, and mood decrease speed.
[*] Renamed "Jigsaw" to "Skilsaw" for clarity and consistency.

[/list]

[/list]

That concludes today's report. Thank you for your unwavering support, and we look forward to seeing you in the next update!

notes.title: Playtest Success: Early Demo Release & Continuous Improvements!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Everyone,[/b]

[h3]Exciting Playtest Output[/h3]

Big news from the world of "E-Startup 2: Business Tycoon"! Our recent playtesting phase has been a success, and we've made great strides in refining game design, fixing bugs, enhancing the game experience, and overall making the game a lot more fun and stable. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we can't thank our playtesters enough for their contributions.

[h3]Early Demo Release Announced![/h3]

Given the positive progress and the stability we've achieved, we're excited to announce that we're moving to an early demo release! This means you'll get a sneak peek at "E-Startup 2: Business Tycoon" sooner than expected. This demo will give you a taste of what it's like to build your business empire from the ground up, facing the challenges of the market head-on.

[h3]Behind the Scenes: Continuous Improvements[/h3]

But that's not all! While the demo gives you a glimpse into our world, behind the scenes, we're tirelessly working to add more features, polish existing ones, and ensure that the final game exceeds your expectations. As an indie developer working solo on this project, your support and feedback mean the world to me. It's your encouragement that fuels my passion and dedication to making "E-Startup 2: Business Tycoon" the best game it can be.

[h3]Stay Tuned and Thank You[/h3]

Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready to dive into the early demo and continuous improvements!

[b]Thank you for being part of this journey. Let's make "E-Startup 2: Business Tycoon" a game we can all be proud of.[/b]
